digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping job and harness contract
propositions: On-demand CI job must map the amd64-only Jira DC image and declare its contract as committed data instead of discovering it at test runtime

The mapping tool must answer a specific checklist of questions (issue types, workflows, statuses, field IDs, screen presence, REST capabilities, link direction) with raw request/response evidence, not prose
Four hardcoded vocabularies (priority, type, status, link relation) and five length limits must be validated live against the instance to detect mismatches before silent failures occur
The job must be manually dispatched only (never on push/PR/schedule) and must not re-derive the contract at test time; consumption is by assertion in conftest.py
Link type direction must be validated end-to-end (write A→B, read back both directions) because name-only checks cannot detect inverted direction bugs
The artifact's image digest must be derived from the Dockerfile pin and asserted as committed data so staleness is detectable on re-pin
